This is the report I care about most. Ariadne's whole argument is that it shows
records rather than guesses, so a number it cannot back up is worse than a
feature it does not have.

## What the screen claimed

## What is actually true

And how you know: a file that exists but is not listed, a count you checked by
hand, a session you know was running.

## Which kind is it?

- [ ] A **count** disagrees with the list under it
- [ ] A **file** the agent wrote is missing from the list
- [ ] A **file** is listed that was never written
- [ ] A **column** is empty (model, project, branch, last action)
- [ ] *Last seen* does not match reality
- [ ] The **live-session warning** fired when it should not have, or did not fire
      when two agents were live on one branch
- [ ] A **summary** or **tone** reading claimed something the transcript does not
      support
- [ ] Something else
